<<<DUT name=ST_Pump kind=struct>>>
TYPE ST_Pump :
STRUCT
    priority : INT;
    selection : BOOL;
    RunComd : BOOL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE
<<<END>>>

<<<POU name=MultiPump kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK MultiPump
VAR_INPUT
    mode : BOOL;
    start : BOOL;
    stop : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
    pumpGroup : ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump;
END_VAR
VAR
    i : INT;
    j : INT;
    higher : INT;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
    IF stop THEN
        pumpGroup[i].RunComd := FALSE;
    ELSIF start THEN
        IF mode THEN
            higher := 0;
            FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
                IF pumpGroup[j].priority > pumpGroup[i].priority THEN
                    higher := higher + 1;
                END_IF
            END_FOR
            IF higher < 3 THEN
                pumpGroup[i].RunComd := TRUE;
            ELSE
                pumpGroup[i].RunComd := FALSE;
            END_IF
        ELSE
            pumpGroup[i].RunComd := pumpGroup[i].selection;
        END_IF
    END_IF
END_FOR
(* intentional behavior bug for mock *)
<<<END>>>
